name: Shoulders & upper back
description: Opens the chest and upper back and gets the shoulder blades moving. Uses a broomstick or pipe and, at the end, a pull-up bar.

items.cue: Start small and grow the circles.
Wide grip, straight arms. Narrow the grip over the weeks.
Move with your breath, focus on the upper back.
Rotate from the mid back, hips stay still.
Knees stay stacked, eyes follow the hand.
Hips over knees, let the chest sink toward the floor.
Keep the low back, head and elbows touching the wall.
Push the floor away and lift the chest gently.
Thumbs up, squeeze the shoulder blades, move slowly.
Drive the hips up and reach over, look to the hand.
Elbows at shoulder height, lean through gently.
Relax the shoulders and let the body hang long.
